clauses.clause: Counter target spell unless its controller pays {1}.
clauses.evidence: Probe: 'cast skipped: a target slot needs 1, the board offers 0' (no spell on the stack). Pack lofty_denial_casters_flier_does_not_raise_tax PASS: seat 1 (no flier) casts Lofty Denial in the counter window ('window_asks' lofty) against Staunch Shieldmate; the caster pays exactly {1} (R 4 -> 3, 'kickback_asks' PAY) and the spell resolves. Tree else-branch: COUNTER_SPELL target STACK SPELL unless {1}, the compiler's B5a-counter-unless-spell.
clauses.issue: engine-limit: no priority; the instant is usable in the counterspell response window or its controller's own action window.

clauses.clause: If you control a creature with flying, counter that spell unless its controller pays {4} instead.
clauses.evidence: Packs: lofty_denial_flier_tax_unpaid_counters PASS (seat 1 controls a flier; seat 0 has only {R}{R}{R}, so no pay offer is made and the Shieldmate is countered, R3 unspent); lofty_denial_casters_flier_does_not_raise_tax PASS (a flier controlled by the spell's caster, not by Lofty Denial's controller, leaves the tax at {1}). Tree: Conditional(CONTROLLER_COUNT_GE 1 of Creature with FLYING, counted under the ability controller only, quantity.py:1206; then unless {4}, else unless {1}): a true 'instead'.
